cases.source_xml:
<chapter id="2" level="1">
  <flow>
    <text role="body">
      <fragment page_index="1" source_order="4" bbox="285,1073,2191,1982">We present DeepSeek- OCR as an initial investigation into the feasibility of compressing long contexts via optical 2D mapping. DeepSeek- OCR consists of two components: DeepEncoder and DeepSeek3B- MoE- A570M as the decoder. Specifically, DeepEncoder serves as the core engine, designed to maintain low activations under high- resolution input while achieving high compression ratios to ensure an optimal and manageable number of vision tokens. Experiments show that when the number of text tokens is within 10 times that of vision tokens (i.e., a compression ratio <inline_expr kind="\(">< 10\times</inline_expr> ), the model can achieve decoding (OCR) precision of <inline_expr kind="\(">97\%</inline_expr> . Even at a compression ratio of <inline_expr kind="\(">20\times</inline_expr> , the OCR accuracy still remains at about <inline_expr kind="\(">60\%</inline_expr> . This shows considerable promise for research areas such as historical long- context compression and memory forgetting mechanisms in LLMs. Beyond this, DeepSeek- OCR also demonstrates high practical value. On OmniDocBench, it surpasses GOT- OCR2.0 (256 tokens/page) using only 100 vision tokens, and outperforms MinerU2.0 ( <inline_expr kind="\(">6000+</inline_expr> tokens per page on average) while utilizing fewer than 800 vision tokens. In production, DeepSeek- OCR can generate training data for LLMs/VLMs at a scale of <inline_expr kind="\(">200k+</inline_expr> pages per day (a single A100- 40G). Codes and model weights are publicly accessible at http://github.com/deepseek- ai/DeepSeek- OCR.</fragment>
    </text>
  </flow>
</chapter>
cases.translated_text: 我们将DeepSeek-OCR作为通过光学二维映射压缩长上下文可行性的初步研究。DeepSeek-OCR由两个组件构成：DeepEncoder和作为解码器的DeepSeek3B-MoE-A570M。具体而言，DeepEncoder作为核心引擎，旨在高分辨率输入下保持低激活值，同时实现高压缩比，以确保视觉token数量最优且可控。实验表明，当文本token数量在视觉token数量的10倍以内（即压缩比<10×）时，模型能够达到97%的解码（OCR）精度。即使在20×的压缩比下，OCR准确率仍保持在约60%。这对于历史长上下文压缩和LLM中的记忆遗忘机制等研究领域显示出相当大的前景。除此之外，DeepSeek-OCR还展现出很高的实用价值。在OmniDocBench上，它仅使用100个视觉token就超越了GOT-OCR2.0（256 token/页），并在使用少于800个视觉token的情况下优于MinerU2.0（平均每页6000+ token）。在生产环境中，DeepSeek-OCR可以每天以200k+页的规模为LLM/VLM生成训练数据（单张A100-40G）。代码和模型权重可在http://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR公开获取。

cases.name: contribution-page3
cases.source_xml:
<chapter id="4" level="1">
  <flow>
    <text role="body">
      <fragment page_index="3" source_order="4" bbox="285,1330,2188,1789">First, we provide comprehensive quantitative analysis of vision- text token compression ratios. Our method achieves <inline_expr kind="\(">96\% +</inline_expr> OCR decoding precision at <inline_expr kind="\(">9 - 10\times</inline_expr> text compression, <inline_expr kind="\(">\sim 90\%</inline_expr> at <inline_expr kind="\(">10 - 12\times</inline_expr> compression, and <inline_expr kind="\(">\sim 60\%</inline_expr> at <inline_expr kind="\(">20\times</inline_expr> compression on Fox [21] benchmarks featuring diverse document layouts (with actual accuracy being even higher when accounting for formatting differences between output and ground truth), as shown in Figure 1(a). The results demonstrate that compact language models can effectively learn to decode compressed visual representations, suggesting that larger LLMs could readily acquire similar capabilities through appropriate pretraining design.</fragment>
    </text>
  </flow>
</chapter>
cases.translated_text: 首先，我们对视觉-文本标记压缩比率进行了全面的定量分析。我们的方法在Fox [21]基准测试上实现了：在9-10倍文本压缩下达到96%以上的OCR解码精度，在10-12倍压缩下达到约90%，在20倍压缩下达到约60%，这些基准测试涵盖了多样化的文档布局（若考虑输出与真实值之间的格式差异，实际准确率甚至更高），如图1(a)所示。结果表明，紧凑型语言模型能够有效地学习解码压缩后的视觉表示，这表明更大的LLM可以通过适当的预训练设计轻松获得类似的能力。

cases.name: deepencoder-pages5-6
cases.source_xml:
<chapter id="11" level="3">
  <flow>
    <text role="body">
      <fragment page_index="5" source_order="7" bbox="285,2505,2188,3126">DeepEncoder mainly consists of two components: a visual perception feature extraction component dominated by window attention, and a visual knowledge feature extraction component with dense global attention. To benefit from the pretraining gains of previous works, we use SAM- base (patch- size 16) and CLIP- large as the main architectures for the two components respectively. For CLIP, we remove the first patch embedding layer since its input is no longer images but output tokens from the previous pipeline. Between the two components, we borrow from Vary [36] and use a 2- layer convolutional module to perform <inline_expr kind="\(">16\times</inline_expr> downsampling of vision tokens. Each convolutional layer has a kernel size of 3, stride of 2, padding of 1, and channels increase from 256 to 1024. Assuming we input a <inline_expr kind="\(">1024\times 1024</inline_expr> image, the DeepEncoder will segment it into <inline_expr kind="\(">1024 / 16\times 1024 / 16 = 4096</inline_expr> patch tokens. Since the first half of encoder is dominated by window attention and only 80M, the activation is acceptable. Before entering global attention,</fragment>
      <asset ref="image" page_index="6" bbox="318,351,2149,912" asset_hash="482a18128256084b3cfa90fd2c94704689bc1a805b88db2a3e128dc800f52a41">
        <content>Figure 4 | To test model performance under different compression ratios (requiring different numbers of vision tokens) and enhance the practicality of DeepSeek-OCR, we configure it with multiple resolution modes. </content>
      </asset>
      <fragment page_index="6" source_order="1" bbox="285,1200,2186,1316">the 4096 tokens go through the compression module and the token count becomes 4096/16=256, thus making the overall activation memory controllable.</fragment>
    </text>
  </flow>
</chapter>
cases.translated_text: DeepEncoder主要由两个组件构成：一个以窗口注意力为主的视觉感知特征提取组件，以及一个具有密集全局注意力的视觉知识特征提取组件。为了从前人工作的预训练收益中获益，我们分别使用SAM-base（patch-size 16）和CLIP-large作为这两个组件的主要架构。对于CLIP，我们移除了第一个patch embedding层，因为其输入不再是图像，而是来自前一流程的输出token。在两个组件之间，我们借鉴了Vary [36]的做法，使用一个2层卷积模块对视觉token进行16倍下采样。每个卷积层的卷积核大小为3，步长为2，填充为1，通道数从256增加到1024。假设我们输入一张1024×1024的图像，DeepEncoder会将其分割为1024/16×1024/16=4096个patch token。由于编码器的前半部分以窗口注意力为主且仅有80M，激活是可接受的。在进入全局注意力之前，这4096个token经过压缩模块，token数量变为4096/16=256，从而使整体激活内存可控。
